text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It happened one day as Dream Journey's 
debut race drew near.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, I had Dream Journey review the 
debut race simulation that I had put 
together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is terrifyingly sharp. 
Half-baked information wouldn't do her any 
good, so I was inwardly nervous, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――...I see. And by the fourth corner, we 
need to have advanced this far.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It was very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
True, considering my running style and the 
other Umamusume in the race, the plan you 
suggested is the most rational, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for putting this all together. 
Would you let me train according to this 
simulation for the time remaining?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt a small sense of relief. Just as I 
was about to share the plan for our 
upcoming training—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me for interrupting when you're 
busy! You're Dream Journey-san and her 
Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person who appeared was a reporter. 
Hanging from their neck was a press pass 
issued by the academy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm putting together a special 
feature article on the Umamusume making 
their debut this year—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
We'd love to have an interview with Dream 
Journey! If possible, could you spare us a 
little of your time?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...We haven't started training yet, so I 
don't mind at all. That is, assuming it's 
fine with you, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
I'm fine with it too, as long as Journey's 
okay with it.
If Journey is fine with it, I'm okay too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Still, I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To think someone would want to interview 
me. ...As you can see, I'm not a 
particularly flashy Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be so modest! Out of all the 
pre-debut Umamusume, you're the one I'm 
paying the closest attention to!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
After all, it just clicked the moment I 
laid eyes on it...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, Dream Journey's running 
style is clearly influenced by that 
"Umamusume who saw the golden light"—Stay 
Gold!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I am flattered. Just as you guessed, 
she is someone I truly look up to.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Actually, I'm a huge fan of 
hers! I've been following her races 
forever...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"And so, since Dream Journey-san reminds 
us so much of Stay Gold-san, we just HAD 
to ask about your enthusiasm for the 
future!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That is— ............an honor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Getting right down to business, let's 
first discuss your debut race—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, Dream Journey handled the 
rest of the interview flawlessly, bringing 
it to a successful close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days later. The article based on 
the interview was published—

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
"—Dream Journey self-proclaimed that she 
was heavily influenced by Stay Gold in 
many ways."

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
"Her running truly brings back the image 
of that Umamusume who reached the golden 
heights within all of us—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, this Dream Journey girl... her 
running style really does have a vibe 
similar to Stay Gold...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"—'Admiration', huh. I wonder if they'll 
run the same path as Stay Gold? I can't 
help but hope so."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...The reception seems pretty good, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...However, this passage is... a bit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—While reviewing the published article 
alone in the Trainer's office, one 
particular part caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
"—When one speaks of Stay Gold, after all, 
what comes to mind is her long running 
career and how memorably she clashed with 
so many legendary Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
"Though unable to claim victory, their run 
helped ignite that legendary race—an 
unforgettable performance by a magnificent 
supporting player."

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
“Will Dream Journey's future races serve 
to remind us of her once again? One cannot 
help but watch closely--”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The article's assessment of Stay Gold 
is by no means wrong. I can see where 
they're coming from myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... I have doubts about simply 
pigeonholing Stay Gold as a famous 
supporting actor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the grand scope of racing 
history, there is indeed that aspect to 
it... but that is not all it is. A part of 
me strongly believes that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And more than anything, it isn't about 
Stay Gold—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh. Were you reading that article as 
well, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, this is perfect timing. 
There was something about this that I 
wanted to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――About how "Big Sis" was written about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The aroma tickles my nostrils.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey questioned me in her usual 
calm tone of voice. At least, she should 
have. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, just for a moment 
earlier... her voice and expression felt 
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, there's no deep meaning behind it, 
you know? It's purely out of curiosity. 
Take it easy.
choice_data_list:
…It'll be a pretty vague impression, but 
is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind. Please, do tell me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared with Dream Journey the strange 
feeling of dissonance I had felt regarding 
the public evaluation of Stay Gold...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Is that so. So you felt that way as well, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Just as you say, there is no 
mistake in what is written.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However... that is not the essence of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: For example—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A race of the century. Where "storms" 
gathered to vie for supremacy— a supreme 
clash still passed down in stories today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As everyone lauded the victor's glorious 
feat... and bathed in the lingering 
afterglow of her brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――"Big Sis" suffered a crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...She must have acutely felt her own 
powerlessness before that "storm." And 
yet—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......That person was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Holding her head higher than any of the 
runners. Looking happier than even the 
victor. With a childlike golden glint in 
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't understand a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Why can they smile so happily, so 
joyfully, even after losing?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I couldn't understand it 
at all, Iâ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —I feared it, and I yearned for it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Within her heart, there is likely no 
such thing as putting up a good fight, a 
narrow defeat, or being a lead or 
supporting actor."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Finding affection or purpose in those race 
records is surely just a matter of 
convenience for us, the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The way of being, the very essence of the 
Umamusume known as "Big Sis"... lies 
beyond such things—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I let my personal feelings 
get a bit too involved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What you just said seems to have put into 
words one aspect of that incredible aura I 
once felt from Stay Gold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, within myself... aside from the 
talk about Stay Gold, I still had 
lingering thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......Is there something else in this 
article that catches your attention, 
Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me, if you wouldn't mind. You 
just listened to my story earlier, after 
all. I think it's my turn now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Dream Journey-san, being 
reminiscent of Stay Gold-san, we simply 
had to ask you about your enthusiasm for 
the future!"

text_block_list.name: Article Body
text_block_list.text:
“Will Dream Journey's future races serve 
to remind us of her once again? One cannot 
help but watch closely--”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list:
—I just wanted you to look at Journey 
more.

—I just wanted you to look at Journey 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To me, the article felt as though it 
were reminiscing about Stay Gold through 
the lens of an Umamusume named Dream 
Journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And to be honest, as her Trainer... I 
didn't quite like that.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe you don't feel that way, but...
...Maybe you don't feel that way, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That day, seeing herself compared to 
Stay Gold, Dream Journey didn't seem to 
mind it at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hence, it is also true that I felt voicing 
this discontent might somehow end up 
casting a damper on things—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I certainly didn't feel bad 
about being called 'Big Sis' again and 
again."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Trainer-san, you feeling 
dissatisfied about it would by no means 
'dampen the mood.'

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...And besides—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I deliver results from now on, I'm sure 
people will see me for who I truly am. So 
please, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So... let's focus on doing our best in the 
debut race first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She swore to herself to work even harder 
from now on so that everyone would see 
Dream Journey for who she truly was—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...So, you just wanted me to look at you 
more, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Truly... such a kind person...—
